verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Buzz has named channels and some thread support. Rooms can be named and described, channels can be created with a --type stream, agents "post the threads," and the agent benchmark grades a reply-to-thread task. A feature branch can also become its own room. Nothing shows that every conversation must sit under a named topic or thread, or that there are catch-up tools for busy channels. Missing for 10: mandatory named-topic/thread organization of all messages, thread or topic naming, documentation of thread UI and catch-up workflows (unread or topic summaries), and hands-on corroboration.
